Attribute.Name: DescriptionHistory
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{ i:=iterate( revisions(), 'concatenate(stepid()," | ",stepname()," | ",revisionname()," | ",if(exact(prodval("Description"),""),"N/A",prodval("Description"))," | ",revisioncreatedate()," | ",revisioneditdate()," | ",revisioneditedby()," | ",revisioncomment())' ) }

concatenate(
"ID | Name | REV Number | Attribute Value | REV Createdate | REV Editdate | REV Editedby | REV Comment",
"\n",
list(i, "\n")
)"/>
